basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1684. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1684 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A Dutch interior seen through a series of rooms: a man sits and a woman stands by a bright window in the middle distance, a small dog crosses the tiled floor, and open doorways lead the eye back into further rooms and light.
alt.zh: 一个可以一路看穿几个房间的荷兰室内：中景里一个男人坐着、一个女人站在明亮的窗边，一只小狗走过铺砖的地面，敞开的门口把视线引向更深处的房间和光。

note.en: De Hooch's speciality was the view through: one room opening into another and another, each with its own light. The couple is almost secondary; the real subject is the house and the way daylight passes through it. A library is built the same way, room after room, each opening onto the next.
note.zh: 德·霍赫最擅长“穿透的视线”：一个房间通向另一个，再通向另一个，每一间都有自己的光。那对年轻人几乎是次要的，真正的主题是这座房子，以及日光怎样穿过它。图书馆也是这样建起来的：一间接一间，每一间都通向下一间。
